plugins.name: appa-runtime
plugins.description: Protects a Claude Code session's flows through the appa-runtime process: every prompt, tool call, tool result, and child return is checked before it proceeds. Hooks fail closed - the runtime process must be running first. Only sessions launched with APPA_GATE=1 are protected; they start the installed runtime on demand, and an unprotected session offers the runtime install as a prompted task.
